cohort: A single woman with stage IV Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumor (PSTT) and high levels of PD-L1 staining and tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs).
finding: A combination of surgery, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy with pembrolizumab can achieve complete remission in a patient with stage IV Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumor.
